parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: ShareType
parameters.description: The share type of the parameter.

parameters.name: WithDecryption
parameters.description: Specifies whether to decrypt the parameter value. The parameter value is returned in the Value response parameter only if this parameter is set to true. Otherwise, the Value response parameter is empty.
